title: Local Inference of LLMs on Long Contexts: A Data Systems Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.28223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can solve complex problems across a variety of subjects, such as mathematics and coding. For such complex analytical tasks, models with a long context perform better. Serving models with long context is currently mostly done on powerful systems with multiple GPUs, which are too expensive for most users. An alternative is local inference, or serving a model on a user's own machine, which removes per-token costs and rate limits, besides keeping sensitive data private and giving users full control over the models they run. The common understanding, however, is that local LLMs need compression (e.g., quantization) to run on a single GPU. In this paper, we set out to study the limitations that prevent serving long-context models for single users, besides the capacity issue. translated_title: 大语言模型在长上下文上的本地推理：一种数据系统的视角
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够解决跨多种学科的复杂问题，例如数学和编程。对于这类复杂的分析任务，具有长上下文的模型表现更好。目前，长上下文模型的服务大多在配备多个GPU的强大系统上进行，这对大多数用户而言过于昂贵。一种替代方案是本地推理，即在用户自己的机器上运行模型，这不仅可以免除按token计费的成本和速率限制，还能保护敏感数据的隐私，并让用户对其运行的模型拥有完全的控制权。然而，普遍的认知是，本地大语言模型需要压缩（例如量化）才能在单个GPU上运行。在本文中，我们着手研究除容量问题之外，阻碍为单用户提供长上下文模型服务的各种限制因素。我们不是仅仅刻画单个模型在单个GPU上的表现，而是分析不同模型在多代GPU上的行为表现，这使我们得以揭示……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从数据系统视角出发，通过分析不同大语言模型在多代GPU上的运行表现，系统研究了除容量问题之外阻碍单用户本地服务长上下文模型的性能限制与瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper takes a data systems perspective to systematically analyze, across multiple GPU generations, the limitations and bottlenecks that prevent single users from locally serving long-context LLMs beyond mere capacity constraints.
